llama-server-b11752-loading.http is the whole response, head and body, to one streamed Chat
Completions request sent while the server was still loading its model, recorded byte for byte on
2026-10-20 from a running llama-server, not written by hand:

- server: llama.cpp prebuilt release b11752, linux x64, CPU only, started with
  `--alias qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct -c 4096 -np 1 -ngl 0`, the same server and checkpoint as
  llama-server-b11752-text.sse;
- request: POST /v1/chat/completions with
  {"model":"qwen2.5-1.5b-instruct","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]},
  sent repeatedly from the server's start until the first answer came.

The server answered 503 Service Unavailable with a JSON body naming `"Loading model"` and type
`unavailable_error`, and closed the connection. The loopback fixture of the tests replays these
bytes unchanged.
